description: The control panel for a software project built with Claude: documentation, stories, what awaits production, and a traceable request workflow.

rubriques.aide: What happens today, for whom, and why it is not good enough.
What the person must be able to do, said simply. Not the technical solution.
One line per criterion, checkable in La Fabrique ("When I…, I see…").
Which pages or tabs are concerned.
None, or which: La Fabrique keeps GitHub logins, roles and an activity log; anything new must be stated here.
One or two sentences for the release notes, without jargon. Empty if nothing is visible.
What remains to decide before coding.
